text:
acme-cs: Hi team, something regressed for our chatbot after last night's draft rollout. We started seeing much shorter answers and a few hallucinations (fabricated dates/facts). This started ~02:20 UTC. Examples and repro below — please escalate. :warning:

acme-cs: Repro steps:
1) Use model redwood-draft-v2 via API (rollout id: rollout/draft-2026-03-16).
2) Payload sets speculative_decoding: true and max_new_tokens: 60 (our default).
3) Prompt: 'Summarize Q3 earnings for Acme Corp and list product launch dates.'

acme-cs: Observed output (truncated/incorrect):
```
Customer: Summarize Q3 earnings for Acme Corp and list product launch dates.
Model: Acme had a strong Q3 with revenue growth of 57% and launched the Nimbus product on 2025-11-01. For more info, see our press release.
```
(acme-cs: Nimbus launch is incorrect — no such product or date.)

support-bot: Thanks for the report — filing internal ticket INC-3456 and pinging @elaine @aj for triage. :rotating_light:

elaine: Hi — can you paste the exact API request you used (headers + body) and any request_id from the logs? Also confirm whether you saw a sudden step-change after the rollout or a gradual drift.

acme-cs: Here's the curl we ran:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-..." 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-draft-v2","prompt":"Summarize Q3 earnings for Acme Corp and list product launch dates.","speculative_decoding":true,"max_new_tokens":60}'
```
Request ids we captured: req_8a9f2c11, req_8a9f2c2e, req_8a9f2c9f. The change was abrupt — started immediately after the draft rollout time.

aj: Thanks, I was on the rollout last night. We enabled redwood-draft-v2 with speculative decoding as the default for draft channel (rollout/draft-2026-03-16). Possible that speculative decoding heuristics are triggering premature terminations or a candidate scoring bug.

aj: Quick triage plan: 1) Reproduce locally against draft-v2 with your prompt and flags. 2) Run with speculative_decoding=false and compare. 3) If consistent, rollback traffic from draft to stable for your org and start a hotfix.

kevin: Can you share the full API response objects for those request ids (including timing fields: latency_ms, tail_latency_ms, decoding_steps)? I want to check if we hit any timeouts or token budget issues. Also pinging infra logs for any GC / OOM during that window.

acme-cs: Pasted one full response (redacted keys):
```
{
  "request_id":"req_8a9f2c11",
  "model":"redwood-draft-v2",
  "latency_ms":240,
  "decoding_steps":12,
  "output":"Acme had a strong Q3 with revenue growth of 57%... Nimbus launched on 2025-11-01.",
  "tokens_generated":34
}
```
We expected ~50-80 tokens. This looks like it stopped early.

aj: That lines up with speculative picking a short candidate. Two actionable things now: disable speculative decoding for your requests (patch on client) and we can trigger a rollback of the draft rollout for affected customers. Which do you prefer first?

acme-cs: Please rollback for us first if possible — we have SLAs and this is customer-facing. We'll also toggle the flag on our side as a temporary mitigation. :pray:

elaine: @sanjay can we force-traffic-back to the stable variant for the Acme org (org id: org-acme-77) and block the draft variant until we fix speculative? Need a quick window for the rollback and a post-check.

sanjay: I can do that. We'll reroute org-acme-77 to redwood-stable-1.4 and pin for 2 hours to validate. Doing immediate capacity check — should be fine for low QPS. ETA to flip: ~8 minutes. I'll post back when done.

kevin: I'll tail logs and check for any infra anomalies in the rollout window and correlate with req_ ids. If we see resource stress that's a separate issue.

support-bot: Ticket INC-3456 updated: rollback requested; assigned to platform and ml-eng.

(8 minutes later)

sanjay: Done — traffic for org-acme-77 moved to redwood-stable-1.4. Canary disabled for that org. Please retest and paste an example if you still see issues.

acme-cs: Testing now... new response looks back to expected length and correct facts. Example: "Acme Q3: revenue +8%, product launches: none in Q3, press release link..." Looks good. Thanks! :thumbsup:

elaine: Great — I'll keep the draft rollout paused for wider traffic until we get a fix. @aj please capture a minimal repro and add to INC-3456 with suggested code/flag changes. We'll schedule a short postmortem to determine if we change the default for speculative decoding on draft channels.

aj: Will reproduce, add logs, and propose a fix (likely candidate scoring/length priors in speculative sampler).

kevin: I'll add infra timeline and latency traces to the ticket.

support-bot: INC-3456 status -> mitigated.

elaine: Closing loop for now. Follow-up actions: 1) ML to root cause speculative scoring (aj). 2) Platform to add a fast rollback runbook for draft rollouts (sanjay). 3) Support to notify affected customers and confirm resolution (acme-cs). I'll open a brief postmortem doc. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
